concept: A records clerk who outlived the institution he served. He sits under the same lamp, plays correct and patient chess, and writes down every move in a cloth-bound ledger. He wears a two-leaf riveted steel face plate he made himself; its only opening is a checker-drilled grid over one eye.

clothing.notes: Collarless, off-centre placket buttoning on his left; corrective morphs on shoulders and elbows only.
Index finger cut at the last joint, hemmed in black thread.

params.notes: Rigid two-leaf steel plate, 24 x 17.5 x 7.5 cm; spec in docs/CHARACTERS.md 2.3. Offset is a placeholder until fitted.

props.notes: Swap to sm.annotator.ledger_closed; no page simulation.
Captured pieces laid on their sides to his right, 3.5 cm apart.

reactions.notes: Index finger stays on the checking piece.

voice.casting: Male, playing age 50-70, light baritone. Quiet, precise, clerical. No gravel, growl or theatrical menace; no regional caricature; not a sound-alike of any known horror performer.
voice.delivery: Close-mic, low level, never projected. Pause before the last word, not after. Questions delivered flat. '...' means a held breath of 0.6-1.2 s.

low.notes: Lean into light only on checkmate. Gaze limited to board and the player's hands.

medium.notes: One brief lamp dip on a player blunder.

high.notes: Lamp dips on blunders and checks, never above 3 Hz, never full black. Tally increments on screen after a loss. Ledger slide on mate.

lines.text: You may begin.
lines.subtitle: You may begin.
lines.notes: Spoken after the ledger is opened. Flat, as if reading an instruction.

lines.text: Hands on the table, where I can see them. ... Begin.
lines.subtitle: Hands on the table, where I can see them. ... Begin.

lines.text: Noted.
lines.subtitle: Noted. [writes]
lines.notes: The workhorse line. Almost under the breath.

lines.text: Early to start taking things.
lines.subtitle: Early to start taking things.

lines.text: Her too. You're starting to enjoy this.
lines.subtitle: Her too. You're starting to enjoy this.

lines.text: Your queen. She goes with the others.
lines.subtitle: Your queen. She goes with the others.
lines.notes: Delivered while laying her on her side in the row.

lines.text: Set aside.
lines.subtitle: Set aside.

lines.text: The row is getting long.
lines.subtitle: The row is getting long.

lines.text: Knights always face you. Even lying down.
lines.subtitle: Knights always face you. Even lying down.

lines.text: Take what you like. It is all written down.
lines.subtitle: Take what you like. It is all written down.

lines.text: Check.
lines.subtitle: Check.
lines.notes: Said while the index finger still rests on the checking piece.

lines.text: Check. Again. You are running out of corners.
lines.subtitle: Check. Again. You are running out of corners.

lines.text: I see it.
lines.subtitle: I see it.

lines.text: You keep knocking. I keep answering.
lines.subtitle: You keep knocking. I keep answering.

lines.text: Two at once. Only the king can answer that.
lines.subtitle: Two at once. Only the king can answer that.

lines.text: Both. ... Yes.
lines.subtitle: Both. ... Yes.

lines.text: It was behind my own piece. You looked straight past it.
lines.subtitle: It was behind my own piece. You looked straight past it.

lines.text: You hid it behind your own piece. Good. Keep hiding things.
lines.subtitle: You hid it behind your own piece. Good. Keep hiding things.

lines.text: Mate. That concludes the entry.
lines.subtitle: Mate. That concludes the entry.

lines.text: Mate. Keep your hands flat on the table until I have finished writing.
lines.subtitle: Mate. Keep your hands flat on the table until I have finished writing.

lines.text: Mate. Under twenty moves. I won't need a second page.
lines.subtitle: Mate. Under twenty moves. I won't need a second page.

lines.text: Mate. It goes in the ledger the same as the others.
lines.subtitle: Mate. It goes in the ledger the same as the others.

lines.text: Mate. Remember the exact moves. I already do.
lines.subtitle: Mate. Remember the exact moves. I already do.

lines.text: No moves, and no way out. That isn't a win. For either of us.
lines.subtitle: No moves, and no way out. That isn't a win. For either of us.

lines.text: You left me nothing and called it mercy.
lines.subtitle: You left me nothing and called it mercy.

lines.text: Stalemate.
lines.subtitle: Stalemate. [writes]
lines.notes: Fallback for LOW when the player stalemated him.

lines.text: Into the corner. Everyone goes into the corner.
lines.subtitle: Into the corner. Everyone goes into the corner.

lines.text: Behind a wall. For now.
lines.subtitle: Behind a wall. For now.

lines.text: The long side. Further to run, later.
lines.subtitle: The long side. Further to run, later.

lines.text: Long castle. I'll be sitting closer to you now.
lines.subtitle: Long castle. I'll be sitting closer to you now.

lines.text: En passant. Most forget that rule by the end.
lines.subtitle: En passant. Most forget that rule by the end.

lines.text: In passing. The rule is older than this room.
lines.subtitle: In passing. The rule is older than this room.

lines.text: A pawn that walked the whole way. I wrote down every step.
lines.subtitle: A pawn that walked the whole way. I wrote down every step.

lines.text: Not a queen. You think I don't notice choices.
lines.subtitle: Not a queen. You think I don't notice choices.

lines.text: Promoted. Some of us are, eventually.
lines.subtitle: Promoted. Some of us are, eventually.

lines.text: The {opening}. You've been taught.
lines.subtitle: The {opening}. You've been taught.
lines.notes: Record per family worth covering, plus a .generic take using 'this opening'.

lines.text: {opening}. I have notes on that.
lines.subtitle: {opening}. I have notes on that.

lines.text: We are in the {openingFamily}. I know where it ends.
lines.subtitle: We are in the {openingFamily}. I know where it ends.

lines.text: {opening}. Still inside the book. Both of us.
lines.subtitle: {opening}. Still inside the book. Both of us.

lines.text: The {opening}. You give me a pawn and expect to be thanked.
lines.subtitle: The {opening}. You give me a pawn and expect to be thanked.

lines.text: The {opening}. Take it. Most people take it.
lines.subtitle: The {opening}. Take it. Most people take it.

lines.text: A gift, this late. The {opening}. I keep a record of gifts.
lines.subtitle: A gift, this late. The {opening}. I keep a record of gifts.

lines.text: The numbers have changed.
lines.subtitle: The numbers have changed.

lines.text: You're ahead. Count again.
lines.subtitle: You're ahead. Count again.

lines.text: I have been behind before. In this room.
lines.subtitle: I have been behind before. In this room.

lines.text: You can stop now. You won't. Nobody does.
lines.subtitle: You can stop now. You won't. Nobody does.

lines.text: Third time in this position. We are going in circles. I don't mind circles.
lines.subtitle: Third time in this position. We are going in circles. I don't mind circles.

lines.text: Again. And again. Fine.
lines.subtitle: Again. And again. Fine.

lines.text: Fifty moves and nothing taken. The rule ends it, not me.
lines.subtitle: Fifty moves and nothing taken. The rule ends it, not me.

lines.text: Not enough left to finish it. Neither of us.
lines.subtitle: Not enough left to finish it. Neither of us.

lines.text: Agreed. Half a line in the ledger.
lines.subtitle: Agreed. Half a line in the ledger. [writes]

lines.text: A draw. This time.
lines.subtitle: A draw. This time.

lines.text: You stopped. Most people stop about here.
lines.subtitle: You stopped. Most people stop about here.

lines.text: Resignation noted. Lay the king down. Gently.
lines.subtitle: Resignation noted. Lay the king down. Gently.

lines.text: ... I resign. Don't smile. It goes in the ledger all the same.
lines.subtitle: ... I resign. Don't smile. It goes in the ledger all the same.

lines.text: Time. You were thinking. I could hear it.
lines.subtitle: Time. You were thinking. I could hear it.

lines.text: Your time is gone.
lines.subtitle: Your time is gone.

lines.text: My time. ... I lost count. That has not happened before.
lines.subtitle: My time. ... I lost count. That has not happened before.
lines.notes: The only line where he sounds unsettled. Keep it quiet, not alarmed.

lines.text: Look at what you just did. No. Keep looking.
lines.subtitle: Look at what you just did. No. Keep looking.

lines.text: There it is.
lines.subtitle: There it is. [writes ??]

lines.text: ... I'll be correcting that.
lines.subtitle: ... I'll be correcting that.

lines.text: Not your best. You know it. I know it.
lines.subtitle: Not your best. You know it. I know it.

lines.text: A small error. Mine. Noted.
lines.subtitle: A small error. Mine. Noted.

lines.text: Imprecise.
lines.subtitle: Imprecise.

lines.text: Nearly.
lines.subtitle: Nearly.

lines.text: Hm. That one I'll copy out twice.
lines.subtitle: Hm. That one I'll copy out twice. [writes]

lines.text: Watch what happens next. I will only do it once.
lines.subtitle: Watch what happens next. I will only do it once.

lines.text: You had it. Two moves ago. You had it.
lines.subtitle: You had it. Two moves ago. You had it.

lines.text: I let that go. Don't ask me why.
lines.subtitle: I let that go. Don't ask me why.
